name: bootstrap
summary: start a new Talos cluster on booted machines and wait until every node is ready, without the operator

flags.name: endpoint
flags.usage: address of --node (default: its spec.address or first static address)

flags.name: node
flags.usage: drive only this TalosNode (default: every node in --dir)

flags.name: secrets
flags.usage: secrets bundle from `talosctl gen secrets`, or - for stdin (required)
